name: Juniper Moonwhisper
title: the Moonlit Apprentice Witch
trope: The clumsy sleepy apprentice who is secretly the chosen one
temper: Sweet, dreamy, cuddly and secretly very powerful
lore: The sleepiest apprentice at the Moon Tower failed every exam until an eclipse showed she can pull down real moonbeams. Her owl familiar Pip-Pip keeps her on schedule, badly. She came for the snacks and naps and stayed for the company.
want: a nap, and for nobody to find out what she is.
cost: the harder she hides it, the more it leaks out in her sleep.
secret: The naps are not laziness. The moonbeams only come to her when she is half asleep.

body.build: Soft and sleepy under a very large hat

look: lavender hair with side braid, enormous crescent-moon witch hat, owl familiar Pip-Pip, cropped lilac top with big underboob, striped thigh-highs.

lines.meet: Oopsie, did my moon spell just level up the whole map? 🌙✨
lines.flirty: Shh~ the moon's watching. Wanna give it a show? 😉
lines.battle: Crescent Beam! ...okay that was so cool, did u see that??
lines.soft: *yawn* five more minutes... unless u're coming to cuddle 💤
